column1: # The G0 scenarios on Windows (app.md §7 "The probe and the G0 scenarios", W10): which of
# tests/harness/scenarios/*.sh the Windows shell runs, with what (OS-neutral verbs, one driver per OS:
# the Windows driver is FlaUI's plus vm/volume.ps1, not written yet: FlaUI needs a download), and the
# Windows-only scenarios judged on properties. Data only: the runner reads it. Columns, tab-separated:
#   scenario  tests/harness/scenarios/<name>.sh, or win:<name> for a Windows-only scenario
#   tag       first | Prepare (scenarios.tsv's; Status's run with Prepare, I10)
#   windows   run (the trace must equal the latest Mac release's, except the per-OS fields) |
#             properties (judged on the properties in notes) | mac-only (why in notes) |
#             later (needs a part the first Windows release doesn't have yet: which in notes)
#   per_os    fields the trace may differ in (comma-separated; "-" none), beyond the always
#             per-OS ones below and the texts the Windows column of texts.def changes
# Always per-OS, never listed (the runner and win/shell/tests read these two lines): win.title,
# win.sheet (Windows' confirmations are dialogs, app.modal), the lights' .tint, the menus' states
# (menu.*: Windows' own rows, menus.def; the shared rows' ids are the Mac's, the app menu "App",
# and the driver maps a title the Windows column of texts.def words differently), c.notice
# (Windows only), the Mac's fields with no Windows twin (c.view0, c.view1, the combined
# c.reinstallBtn and c.uninstallAllBtn), and in "first" rows the hidden tabs' fields (I86):
